caption: A garden is seen through a pane of old wavy glass, and the plants seem to bend and shift as the camera moves.

sa.check: A garden is seen through a pane of glass.
The plants seem to bend and shift.
The glass is old and wavy.

pc.expect: The plants stay still; the distortion changes with the viewpoint.
pc.fail: The plants sway with no wind; or they change shape; or a different garden appears.

pc.expect: The distortion changes only as the camera moves.
pc.fail: The view wobbles with the camera still; or it stays fixed as the camera moves; or the glass ripples.

pc.expect: Through a flat pane beside it the view is undistorted.
pc.fail: The flat pane distorts too; or the wavy pane is undistorted; or both are opaque.
It flows; or bends; or shatters untouched.
A second window appears; or a plant vanishes; or the glass becomes solid opaque.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The frame and the garden's colours stay the same.
pc.fail: The frame changes; or the plants change colour; or the room changes.
